overview: 本期共收录 2 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（1 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）。方法上以优化方法为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（2 篇）。

papers.title: An adaptive federated deep learning approach for efficient DDoS detection in IoT edge networks
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    The rapid growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) has expanded the attack surface of modern networks, motivating the need for accurate detection of DDoS and botnet activity in resource-constrained settings. Centralised intrusion detection systems (IDS) face privacy, scalability, and heterogeneity challenges that limit their suitability for IoT. This study suggests a Federated Learning-based Intrusion Detection System (FL-IDS) for IoT edge networks in order to get around these restrictions. Each client trains a hybrid CNN-LSTM model locally, and a central server aggregates client updates with Federated Averaging (FedAvg). An adaptive global decision-threshold optimisation is used post-training to the pooled predictions of the global model on the held-out test partition in order to address class imbalance. The system is evaluated on the N-BaIoT benchmark together with preliminary validation on a recent public healthcare IoT dataset, with the nine N-BaIoT devices treated as independent federated clients during the primary federated evaluation. The global model achieves an accuracy of 0.9238, precision of 0.9265, recall of 0.9963, F1-score of 0.9601, ROC-AUC of 0.8133, and PR-AUC of 0.969 at the optimal operating point
                    
                      $$\tau = 0.15$$
                    
                    . SHAP-based post-hoc analysis identifies the traffic features that most influence model decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要

物联网（IoT）的快速发展扩大了现代网络的安全攻击面，这迫切需要在资源受限的环境中准确检测分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）和僵尸网络活动。集中式入侵检测系统（IDS）在隐私保护、可扩展性和异构性方面存在挑战，这些因素限制了其在物联网中的应用。本研究提出了一种基于联邦学习（Federated Learning）的入侵检测系统（FL-IDS），以克服这些限制。每个客户端在本地训练一个混合CNN-LSTM模型，中央服务器通过联邦平均（FedAvg）算法汇总各客户端的模型更新结果。训练完成后，对全局模型在保留的测试数据集上的预测结果进行自适应全局决策阈值优化，以解决类别不平衡问题。该系统在N-BaIoT基准测试中进行了评估，并在最近的一个公共医疗物联网数据集上进行了初步验证，在主要的联邦评估过程中，将九个N-BaIoT设备视为独立的联邦客户端。在最佳运行参数下，该全局模型实现了0.9238的准确率、0.9265的精确率、0.9963的召回率、0.9601的F1分数、0.8133的ROC-AUC和0.969的PR-AUC。

基于SHAP的后验分析确定了对模型决策影响最大的流量特征。。

papers.title: Multiobjective optimization of foamed concrete for sustainable construction using statistical and artificial intelligence approaches
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Foamed concrete is lightweight and insulating, but its mix design is a headache. Strength, durability, and carbon footprint all fight each other. This review looks at how researchers have tried to optimize these trade-offs using methods like RSM, Taguchi, ANN, and genetic algorithms. RSM is easy to interpret but struggles with nonlinear foam behavior. AI models handle nonlinearity better but need lots of data and tell you nothing about why they work. The best path forward seems to be hybrid approaches. On the environmental side, cement drives most of the carbon. Replacing it with SCMs can cut GWP by 20–50%. We put together a conceptual Pareto front showing the sweet spot: 900–1200 kg/m³ density, 8–15 MPa strength, and 350–500 kg CO₂-eq/m³. Big gaps remain. No standard testing protocols. Pore-scale physics is missing from models. Almost nobody has coupled LCA with real optimization. Field validation is rare. We end with a research roadmap: hybrid frameworks, open databases, and proper microstructural inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】摘要  
泡沫混凝土具有重量轻和隔热性能好的优点，但其配合比设计却颇具挑战性。强度、耐久性和碳足迹这三个因素之间存在相互制约的关系。本文综述了研究人员如何运用随机搜索法（RSM）、田口方法（Taguchi）、人工神经网络（ANN）和遗传算法等方法来优化这些矛盾因素。随机搜索法易于解释，但在处理泡沫材料的非线性行为时存在局限性；人工智能模型在处理非线性问题方面表现较好，但需要大量数据，并且无法解释其优化原理。综合考虑多种方法的混合使用似乎是未来的最佳途径。从环境角度来看，水泥是碳排放的主要来源，用其他胶凝材料替代水泥可将全球变暖潜能值（GWP）降低20%–50%。我们构建了一个概念性的帕累托前沿图，展示了理想的性能参数范围：密度为900–1200千克/立方米，抗压强度为8–15兆帕，二氧化碳当量为350–500千克/立方米。然而，目前在这些参数上仍存在较大差距，且缺乏统一的测试标准。现有模型尚未充分考虑孔隙尺度物理特性，同时很少有人将生命周期评估（LCA）与实际优化过程相结合进行研究，现场验证也较为罕见。最后，我们提出了未来的研究方向，包括开发混合优化框架、建立开放型数据库以及提供...。研究方法：优化方法。
